Both responses are accurate and stay within the 120-word limit (B is about 107 words). B is more helpful because it adds useful context A lacks:
- the typical perihelion date range (January 2–5)
- the aphelion distance in early July, for comparison
- why the tilt matters more than distance (sunlight directness)
- the small (~3%) size of the distance variation
